name: podcast-index-client
summary: A minimal Podcast Index API client: signed requests, three lookups (podcast by guid, podcast by feed URL, episode by guid), and an answer that keeps 'not found' apart from 'could not ask', so a rate limit is never cached as a miss.

peer.runtime: Node 18+ server only (node:crypto). Never import it from client code.

env.name: PODCAST_INDEX_KEY
env.why: API key from api.podcastindex.org. Must NOT carry a NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefix: Next.js inlines those into the browser bundle.

env.name: PODCAST_INDEX_SECRET
env.why: API secret, used only inside the sha1 auth hash. Same rule: never NEXT_PUBLIC_.

env.name: APP_NAME
env.why: Sent as the User-Agent. Podcast Index attributes traffic by it; set it to your app's name and version.

rename.why: The fallback User-Agent names the app this came from. Set APP_NAME, or change the fallback, or your requests reach Podcast Index labelled as another app's.

caveats: Answers are raw Podcast Index JSON typed unknown. Type the fields you read yourself.
Three states: { found } and { miss } may be cached; null means the request failed (401, 429, 5xx, timeout, bad JSON) and must never be cached as absent.
Podcast Index says 'not found' with HTTP 400, and sometimes with 200 and an empty object. Both are { miss }.
No retry and no backoff. A 429 returns null; retry later in your own code.
Credentials are read on every call, not at import, so a rotated key takes effect without a restart.
15-second timeout per request, fixed in the file.
